task.object: Deterministic covariance shrinkage of three frozen conditional importance proposals
deliverables: Three normalized defensive Student-mixture NPZ proposals
Covariance audit arrays and finite validation report
Independent raw-NPZ review; no EM/GP/scientific evaluation

assumptions: The recorded component responsibility ESS and training block identities belong to the frozen 12+12 component refined source.
Student shape equals training covariance times SD inflation squared times (df-2)/df.
The conditional scientific target and priors remain unchanged; only the evaluation proposal changes.
mathematical_context.domain: Three layers; each proposal has two blocks of twelve positive-definite 11-dimensional Student-t components plus a logistic prior defensive component.

precision.target_tolerance: Normalization error <=1e-12; independent log-density error <=1e-10; independent covariance reconstruction <=1e-12 absolute.

result.summary: Three fixed normalized covariance-regularized proposals created in 0.188 s with zero EM or GP calls. All 72 component shapes positive definite; means/full probabilities preserved exactly. Independent review passed. This completes candidate construction only, not scientific stability or efficiency validation.

methods: Bitwise preservation of means and full probabilities; unchanged df/epsilon and source NPZ hashes.
Positive-definite checks for all block covariances and 72 component shapes; analytic mixture normalization.
Finite 1024-draw-per-layer proposal-only smoke; save/load logpdf equality.
SciPy independent Student density comparator on nine existing training probes.
Independent longdouble raw-NPZ reconstruction of within+between covariance, ESS shrinkage and Student scale conversion.
verification.residual_or_error: Probability normalization <=1.11e-16; SciPy absolute log-density discrepancy <=8.44e-14; independent covariance absolute discrepancy <=1.78e-15.
limitations: No new likelihood or evidence estimate was computed.
Training density changes are in-sample and do not demonstrate lower variance.
ESS-based d+2 shrinkage is a predetermined proposal heuristic, not a scientific prior or a convergence theorem.
Only fresh independent scientific evaluation can assess importance efficiency.
